metadata.title: Industrial Flow Meters & Level Instruments | Velomac
metadata.description: Explore vortex, electromagnetic, turbine, thermal mass, ultrasonic and differential-pressure flow meters, plus industrial level instruments from Velomac.

hero.title: Industrial Flow Meters & Level Instruments
hero.description: Flow and level instrumentation for industrial applications.

groups.title: Flow Measurement
groups.description: Flow measurement technologies for steam, gas, liquids, water and industrial process applications.

groups.title: Level Measurement
groups.description: Level measurement and local level indication for industrial vessels and tanks.

catalogueDescriptions.vortex-flowmeter: Steam, gas and liquid flow measurement across changing process conditions.
catalogueDescriptions.electromagnetic-flowmeter: For conductive liquids, water, wastewater and chemical applications.
catalogueDescriptions.liquid-turbine-flowmeter: For clean liquid applications with stable flow conditions.
catalogueDescriptions.gas-turbine-flowmeter: For natural gas, industrial gases and compatible gas applications.
catalogueDescriptions.thermal-mass-flowmeter: Direct mass flow measurement for compressed air and industrial gases.
catalogueDescriptions.v-cone-flowmeter: Differential-pressure flow measurement for larger process lines.
catalogueDescriptions.swirl-flowmeter: Gas and steam measurement where compact installation is important.
catalogueDescriptions.balanced-differential-pressure-flowmeter: Differential-pressure flow measurement across process and duct applications.
catalogueDescriptions.ultrasonic-flowmeter: Closed-pipe, clamp-on and other liquid flow measurement applications.
catalogueDescriptions.radar-level-transmitter: Non-contact level measurement for industrial tanks and process vessels.
catalogueDescriptions.magnetic-level-gauge: Direct local level indication for industrial tanks and vessels.

featuredSolution.title: Wide-Turndown Anti-Vibration Vortex Flowmeter
featuredSolution.description: Variable flow and mechanical vibration can challenge the same measurement point. This configuration is developed around both operating conditions.
